comparison: Unchanged Python v5 versus v5 plus validate_confirmed_fires, frozen35ms persistence validation.
selection: For each track: one12s core with maximal isolated kick RMS and one12s core with maximal bass RMS where kick stem is exactly silent. Search starts every4s from8s to duration-20s. Review250ms margins. If no silent-bass12s core exists, report that and use the minimum-kick-RMS12s core as a mixed negative control; never label it kick-free.
labels: Detector-blind source-assisted visual review of stem and mastered waveforms/spectrograms. No BPM/grid-generated labels. No detector execution before final label JSON is frozen. Do not force master to stem timing; unresolved differences explicitly uncertain. Provisional onset intervals, not sample-accurate or independently audible truth.
metrics: Existing score_passage:35/50/70ms symmetric, plus -35/+200ms association diagnostic; unchanged uncertain-region and boundary handling. Full chronological mono masters at native sample rate. No resets/backdating/warp.
acceptance: Retain every v5-associated labelled kick in each reviewed passage under fixed wide association; fewer unmatched fires in aggregate with no increase on either track or any kick-free passage. Added output latency <=35ms; report50/70ms scores and actual associated timing without treating200ms diagnostic tolerance as acceptable latency. If criteria fail, report failure without tuning.
limitations: Two tracks and short visually reviewed passages cannot establish general-purpose reliability. These tracks cease to be independent if later used to guide changes.
